chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad and a number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad and Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, altogether from Ibn Mahboub, from Ibn Ri'ab, from Abu Hamza, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

Indeed, Ali (peace be upon him) used to judge regarding inheritances concerning what was acquired by Islam from the wealth of a polytheist which he left undistributed before Islam. He used to assign for the women and the men their shares from it, according to the Book of Allah, Exalted and Mighty, and the Sunnah of His Prophet (peace be upon him and his family).

key_terms.عَلَى كِتَابِ اللَّهِ: According to the Book of Allah

ai.seo_question: How is the estate of a polytheist distributed if they embrace Islam before death but the wealth was not yet divided?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) ruled that the estate of a polytheist who died before distribution is inherited by their Muslim heirs according to the Quran and Sunnah, a principle known as *al-mawarith li-man qabila al-Islam*. This ruling, recorded in *Al-Kafi*, highlights the Shia jurisprudential view that the faith of the heir, not the deceased, determines inheritance rights in this specific context. It underscores the continuity of prophetic tradition in applying divine law to transitional cases of conversion.
